Fix: Refactor to take Transaction only (preferred) or Connection only.
See CLAUDE.md section on 'Transaction API Design Patterns' for guidance.

======================================================================
Connection/Transaction Anti-Pattern Violations
======================================================================

Functions must accept EITHER Connection OR Transaction, not both.
This anti-pattern creates ambiguity about transaction lifecycle ownership.

Two patterns are detected:
  1. UNION: Single param with Connection|Transaction union type
  2. SEPARATE_PARAMS: Separate optional conn and txn parameters
